messages:
ana: seeing a spike in mTLS handshake failures out of ap-south proxies since ~10:22UTC. TL;DR: KMS unwrap errors for cert private keys. anyone touching keystore RBAC recently?
ops-bot: Alert: [ap-south] proxy-mtls-handshake-failure rate up 4.7% (10m) — linked logs: https://logs.redwood/ap-south/proxy/mtls
mike: I ran an IAM cleanup yesterday to remove a couple of stale roles. I don't recall removing keystore access but lemme check.
jess: can you paste an example error line? helps decide if it's permission or rotation mismatch.
nana: (typo) sorry, ana: here's a sample from the proxy pod logs: 
```
2026-03-21T10:23:07Z proxy-7f6b9 k8s: TLS handshake failed: unwrap private key failed: KMS Decrypt error: AccessDeniedException: User: ... is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:123:key/abcd-...
```
mike: ok that is an AccessDenied from KMS. I do see a recent change: removed role roles/keystore_accessor from serviceAccount:proxy-sa@ap-south on 2026-03-21T02:10Z. probable cause.
tom: yikes. we need a mitigation path before full role restore. Can we enable a local keystore fallback (cached certs) for the region?
nana: we ship a local fallback but it's disabled for security. quick mitigation: flip env `PROXY_ALLOW_LOCAL_KEYCACHE=true` for the ap-south daemonset and restart pods. reduces exposure but unblocks traffic.
jess: patch command (canary single-node first):
```
kubectl -n infra patch daemonset/proxy --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-","value":{"name":"PROXY_ALLOW_LOCAL_KEYCACHE","value":"true"}}]'
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/proxy -n infra --selector=region=ap-south
```
mike: i'll restore the role in IAM now, but we should do it in staged fashion and record exact principal. restoring binds: `gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding` (or AWS equivalent).
ops-bot: Deployment event: daemonset/proxy patched by jess at 2026-03-21T10:29Z (annotation: mtls-fallback-apac).
nana: temporary workaround in place on 2/3 ap-south nodes. handshake failures dropped to 0.8% already.
tom: next steps: 1) restore keystore role for proxy-sa in ap-south with scoped principal. 2) add alert when KMS Decrypt AccessDenied > 0 for any region. 3) audit log query saved and retention bumped for 90d for KMS denies. 4) run a canary rotation to ensure unwrap works.
jess: adding audit query to pager duty runbook: 
```
resource.type="aws_kms" AND protoPayload.error.details: "AccessDenied" AND region="ap-south-1"
```
mike: restoring role now, will post IAM change id. also rolling back the local cache flag after verification.
nana: opened GH issue #5482: "ap-south keystore RBAC removal => KMS AccessDenied -> mtls fallback response" assigned to mike + sec eng. will craft postmortem template.
jess: long term: we should add a pre-merge CI check that flags RBAC IaC diffs touching keystore roles and requires sec review.
tom: also add a canary job that attempts a KMS decrypt with current SA in each region every 6h and alerts on failure.
mike: IAM change applied. change-id iam-change-20260321-33. can someone verify proxies can unwrap?
nana: verified, KMS decrypt succeeds for restored role. rolling pods back to disable local cache now.
nana: final status: incident mitigated at 10:41UTC. follow-up actions tracked in #5482. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Incident closed (auto) — duration 18m.
